But the focus of today's 9to5Toys lunch roundup is on a $500 off M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB and $400 off 48GB model. We also have the Twelve South PlugBug wall charger with Find My at a new Amazon all-time low of $40, the last chance for Nanoleaf's "biggest sale of the year" with up to 50% off smart lighting, mirror lights, desk lamps and more starting from $25, an exclusive discount on a brand new American leather MacBook backpack, and the cheapest Apple Watch Series 11 down $100. More deals to take advantage of like M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB down $500, 48GB model down $400

Beyond the ongoing $50 off July Black Friday deal on AirPods Pro 3 and the $100 discount on AirPods Max 2 across all colors, the new M5 MacBook Pro lineup is still seeing sizeable markdowns. The real standout this time is on the 24GB/2TB M5 Pro 14-inch model, which is now $500 off at Amazon, plus the 48GB model is down $400 at B&H.

This is easily the best M5 Pro MacBook Pro deal we've seen since the price hike went into effect. Amazon is now serving up the 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro for $2,499 with free shipping. Originally $2,999, this one comes equipped with 24GB of RAM and 2TB of built-in storage for $500 off the newer pricing.

Considering Apple just hiked the price of this configuration by $400 recently, and Amazon's price never went below $2,340 before that, this is a particularly solid deal.

Another highlight for MacBook Pro deals this week is B&H's 48GB/1TB 14-inch M5 Pro model that's at $2,799 with free shipping. It's a bit more to get double the RAM, but it's $400 off the original $3,199 price and a configuration that simply isn't available from Amazon.

The new AirTag 2 is still at its July Black Friday all-time low at $22 each

Twelve South PlugBug wall charger with Find My down to $40, new Amazon low

The Twelve South PlugBug 50W USB-C charger with Apple Find My is now down to $40 at Amazon, a nearly 45% discount off the regular price.

Amazon is now offering the Twelve South PlugBug 50W USB-C wall charger for $39.99 with free shipping.

It's listed at $70 originally, then went on sale with the current Twelve South MSRP at $50. That said, it has hovered around $55 for most of the year on Amazon, and has now fallen to a 2026 low. It did dip into the $40 range during Prime Day earlier this year.

Putting aside the unique and very minimalist design, this is basically a practical everyday carry and travel companion that delivers a relatively slim wall charger with two bottom-mounted USB-C slots so you can power up your gear wherever there's an outlet.

The outlet prongs fold in for easy storage and transport, and it maxes out at 50W output, but the real standout feature is the built-in Apple Find My support. It works just like other third-party Find My accessories, quickly connecting to the Find My app and providing the usual tracking and left-behind notifications — a particularly reassuring feature for a charger, especially while traveling in and out of your daily backpack.

Be sure to read through my hands-on review of the Twelve South PlugBug for a closer look at what it offers and how it performs.

Don't miss these July Black Friday Apple Watch Series 11 deals from $299 while they last (down $100)

There's a lot of summer left and if you're still looking to pick up a new Apple wearable, now's the time to act while the most popular Series 11 models are $100 off their regular prices.

We've seen specifically deals on some of the higher-end Apple Watch Series 11 configurations over the past week or so, but if you're after the cheapest — and frankly most bang for your buck — in the lineup, I think these $100 discounts on the base models are the way to go:

  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 $299 (originally $399)
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 $329 (originally $429)

As of this morning/at the time of writing, the entry-level aluminum 42mm and 46mm Series 11 models are still seeing $100 discounts at Amazon. However, we're starting to see some case colors for the larger 46mm model go out of stock, so you'll want to keep an eye on things before prices snap back up.

These discounts are largely on par with the best prices we've seen since launch, with only some models going $20 lower during the June Prime Day event. But with July Black Friday deals wrapping up this weekend, these Apple Watch Series 11 markdowns will likely go with them — and that's already starting to happen.
